name: Terminal
tagline: A shell on this device, in a workspace's environment or on a Linux VM

offers.label: Open shell
offers.description: Opens a shell where the session says it runs and shows it in the window.

offers.label: Restart shell
offers.description: Starts the shell again in the window, where it runs: after it ended, when its connection was

offers.label: Close shell
offers.description: Closes this session's shell on this device, ending for good what runs in it.

offers.label: Open in…
offers.description: Runs the session in another environment, and opens new windows there from now on.

offers.label: Record target
offers.description: Records where the session runs and the device of the window it is set up in.

offers.label: Claim pane
offers.description: Records the pane the session's presence is scoped to.

offers.label: Record relay session
offers.description: Records the relay session this one re-attaches to, or that it re-attaches to none.

offers.label: Run command
offers.description: Runs one command line in the session's shell, at its prompt, and answers once its shell

offers.label: Run in shell
offers.description: Runs a command line in the session's open shell.

offers.label: Stop command
offers.description: Stops the program in the foreground, as Ctrl+C does.

offers.label: Type text
offers.description: Types text at the prompt without pressing Enter.

offers.label: Paste
offers.description: Pastes text into the shell exactly as given. Anyone but the person at the window is asked

offers.label: Paste clipboard
offers.description: Pastes what the clipboard holds: the person at the window, so nothing asks first.

offers.label: Clear screen
offers.description: Clears the screen and its scrollback.

offers.label: Copy visible output
offers.description: Copies what the window shows, without escape sequences.

offers.label: Copy selection
offers.description: Copies the words a selection covers, as the grid hands them over.

offers.label: Select all output
offers.description: Selects everything the session printed and copies it: the grid's whole output.

offers.label: Go to the top
offers.description: The oldest output the session keeps and the newest it shows, as text.

offers.label: Read output
offers.description: What the window shows: its newest output as text, and the public links on it.

offers.label: Inspect editor
offers.description: The editor running in the session that offers its text, when one does: the lease its

offers.label: Replace editor selection
offers.description: Replaces the selection of the editor running in the session, under the lease it gave,

offers.label: Inspect session
offers.description: How the session stands: where it runs, whether its shell is live, and why not.

offers.label: Open link
offers.description: Opens a public web address the session printed, in the browser. A terminal prints what a

offers.label: Finished
offers.description: A run the shell marked finished, as the grid reported it: the person typed it.

offers.label: Record command
offers.description: Records a command that ended on the session where its shell runs for someone who asked with

offers.label: Titled
offers.description: The program set the window's title.

offers.label: Ended
offers.description: The shell exited: the session ends, and the window that showed it closes.

offers.label: Lost
offers.description: The connection to the shell was lost: the window says so and opens it again, re-attaching to

offers.label: Held
offers.description: The session's host holds a command until someone acts, and says why; empty text says it

offers.label: Let go
offers.description: The person let go of the held command: it is cancelled at the prompt.

offers.label: Add card
offers.description: Opens the page where the person adds the card the held command waits for.
